_comment: [CHANGE: claude-code | 2026-07-25] Intentionally EMPTY. mempalace and code-review-graph moved to user scope (~/.claude/settings.json) because Cowork / Claude Desktop launches Claude Code with `--setting-sources=user` and never reads this file -- so a project-scoped registration only works from a terminal. User scope is loaded by both. Do NOT re-add servers here: this file and user scope would then both define the same names, which is the exact duplicate-registration fault behind BUG-085 (whichever scope wins is invisible, so the version you think is running may not be the one answering). `luminos-verify --mcp` fails if any server name is defined in more than one Claude Code scope.
